card.name: Spaces and links before numbers in dementia drug text
card.fires_on: Spacing and small linking words just before a number or dose figure, in text about donepezil, memantine and similar dementia drugs. Often the blank space token right before a digit such as 2, 0.4 or 4.5.

modes.label: Space before a digit
modes.description: A blank space token that comes right before a number in a range, ratio or dose.
modes.example: resolved within 1 to<< >>2 weeks following treatment discontinuation

modes.label: Linking word in dose text
modes.description: A small word such as of, with, and or an opening bracket in sentences about dementia drug doses or trials.

card.plain: It fires on the gap or small word just before a number in dementia drug labels, such as donepezil and memantine.
